notes: No cross-sheet Excel formula references (Sheet!A1 style).
Primary calculation is GGR_USD = GGR_local / FX_rate with hardcoded rates.
Other formulas are SUM totals (grand total + monthly GGR USD subtotals).
Most metric columns are manual inputs.

ggr_usd.notes: FX rate is hardcoded per cell in Excel; website should use fx_rates(currency, month).

grand_total.expression: SUM(metric_col from row 2 to last data row)

known_issues: B1 Grand Total copies SUM(I2:I302) into columns J–S (should sum each column).
Some rows use wrong FX rates for their CCY (e.g. BDT with VND-like 24573/26314).
Rare broken formulas: R{row}/{a}/{b}, incomplete R{row}/, or identity R{row}.
Month often blank on continuation rows — inherit from nearest non-blank above.
Values may be 'n/a' mixed with numbers — treat as null.
NCVIP uses compound CCY labels like 'BDT MCW', 'PHP BPM'.
